04445fe1aca31cfd.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 The Receptionist & Administrative Assistant is the first point of contact for visitors and callers, and keeps the office running day to day. The role combines front-desk duties with administrative support to HR and the wider office, including records, supplies, meeting rooms, travel and vendor coordination. The aim is a professional welcome for every guest and an office where employees have what they need, on time. What Will You Do❓ Reception and Front Desk Administrative Welcome visitors, candidates and clients, verify identity, register them in the visitor log and issue visitor badges. Notify hosts on arrival and escort guests to meeting rooms when needed. Answer and direct incoming calls, take accurate messages and handle general inquiries. Receive, log and distribute incoming mail, couriers and deliveries; arrange outgoing shipments. Keep the reception and waiting area clean, tidy and presentable at all times. Follow building security and access-control procedures and report any security concern immediately. Manage meeting room bookings and prepare rooms with refreshments and equipment. Monitor office supplies and pantry stock, raise purchase requests and track deliveries. Maintain organizing physical and electronic filing for administrative documents. Prepare letters, memos and simple reports, and update trackers and spreadsheets. Coordinate business travel bookings (flights, hotels, transport) in line with the travel policy. Arrange logistics for internal events, meetings and employee engagement activities. Prepare the workstation, access card and welcome pack for new joiners in coordination with IT. Provide support and assistance to other departments and the CEO as needed. Act as the contact point for cleaning, maintenance, security and pantry service providers. Report and follow up on facility issues (air conditioning, lighting, furniture, equipment) until resolved. Track service vendor performance and raise issues with the line manager. Support petty cash handling and keep receipts for office expenses, where assigned. Perform any other related duties assigned by the line manager. What Are We Looking For❓ Diploma or bachelor's degree in business administration, Office Management or a related field. 1 to 2 years of experience in reception, front desk or office administration. Experience in a corporate or regulated environment is a plus. Who Will Excel❓ Fluent spoken and written Arabic and English. Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office or Zoho Workspace (email, Word, Excel, calendars). Professional, friendly presence and clear communication. Strong organization and time management; able to handle several tasks at once. High level of discretion with confidential and personal information. Attention to detail and a service-minded, proactive attitude. Key Performance Indicators All visitors registered in the visitor log, with no unregistered access. Office supplies and pantry items kept in stock, with no stock-outs. Facility issues logged and followed up until closed. New joiners' workstation, access card and welcome pack ready on day one. Positive feedback from employees and visitors on front-desk service.

041a7b170d6be41e.job_title: Senior Solutions Architect AWS Global Sales
041a7b170d6be41e.description: About AWS Global Sales AWS Global Sales drives the adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, supporting customers of all sizes in innovation and expansion. The team focuses on providing tailored service, technology, and consistent support to help customers grow. This approach involves understanding customer challenges and crafting solutions to accelerate their success. Role Overview: Senior Solutions Architect AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is seeking a Senior Solutions Architect to work with Enterprise and Strategic customers in western Saudi Arabia, based in Jeddah. Saudi Arabia is a rapidly growing cloud market, influenced by Vision 2030 and national digital transformation programs across various sectors. This full-time role is central to AWS’s growth strategy in the Kingdom, serving as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of high-profile enterprise customers. The architect will assist customers in modernizing legacy platforms, adopting AI and cloud-native architectures, and accelerating their digital agendas. Key Responsibilities Drive long-term customer success, satisfaction, and trust through the adoption of AWS services and well-architected solutions, in partnership with Account Managers and Business Development. Serve as the primary technical advisor for enterprise customers in the Jeddah and western Saudi Arabia region, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influencing their long-term technology strategy. Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS and lead deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful cloud deployment, including competitive migration paths from other cloud providers to AWS. Conduct one-to-few and one-to-many enablement sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS (*, Dev Days, Immersion Days, Workshops, and GameDays). Capture and share best-practice knowledge amongst the AWS Solutions Architect community; contribute to customer-facing publications such as white papers, blog posts, and reference architectures. Act as a technical liaison between customers, AWS Service Teams, and Support, gathering product feedback, driving feature requests, and mentoring fellow Solutions Architects in the region. A Day in the Life of a Senior Solutions Architect A Senior Solutions Architect in Jeddah focuses on customer impact. Daily activities may include preparing architecture proposals for enterprise customers considering migration to AWS, or joining deep-dive technical sessions to whiteboard microservices architectures and advise on compute, AI/ML, and data services. Collaboration with Account Managers and the wider account team on strategy calls, leading workshops or Immersion Days for developers on topics like Amazon Bedrock, GenAI application patterns, or container modernization with EKS are also part of the role. Time is also spent capturing feedback on product gaps, drafting blog posts, or reviewing teammate architectures. The role involves internal syncs, knowledge-sharing sessions, and event preparation, with a consistent focus on being a trusted technical partner for customer success on AWS. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technical role. Ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges. Broad competence across multiple technology areas including Generative AI, Agentic AI, cloud infrastructure, security, DevOps, databases, application development, and data analytics. Deep expertise in at least 2-3 of the aforementioned technology areas. Ability to connect technology solutions with measurable business value for customers. Experience engaging with various customer stakeholders, including CxOs, VPs, Directors, Architects, Developers, and Engineers. Application Process AWS EMEA SARL (Saudi Arabia Branch) is seeking qualified candidates for this Senior Solutions Architect position in Makkah, Jeddah. Salary details are not disclosed for this full-time role.

04a0ab74c910e6c6.description: About Veolia Water Technologies Veolia aims to be a benchmark company for ecological transformation, committed to creating a positive impact for the planet. Veolia Water Technologies provides complete solutions for water treatment, innovating in areas such as sustainable development and resource recovery. In Saudi Arabia, the company empowers employees to make decisions and drive change. The Role: Drafting Coordinator EPP Veolia Water Technologies is seeking a Drafting Coordinator EPP to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role requires 2-5 years of experience and involves coordinating and managing CADD workflows, ensuring quality standards, and supporting engineering design processes. Key Responsibilities Coordinate, manage, and oversee computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) workflows for both 3D and 2D software models. Review rough sketches and supervise the production of detailed work using CADD systems. Lead the preparation, review, and redrafting processes in close coordination with the engineering team. Manage, maintain, and audit drawing archives and organized records, ensuring proper documentation of all revisions, updates, and transmittals. Assist, participate, and coordinate in the compilation of basic process design data; finalize process scheme and equipment selection. Act as the primary liaison to assist design engineers for process and design. Carry out, review, and approve process and detailed designs, specifically for piping and gas. Prepare and verify preliminary designs, drawings, detailed drawings, and fabrication details. Participate with the design engineer in the final selection of process, plant, and equipment. Liaise actively with project and proposals engineers to ensure smooth implementation of design; carry out design checks and certification as required. Oversee product standardization and manage project engineering documentation systems. Carry out any other duties related to the area of expertise as assigned by the design manager or designee. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to work under tight deadlines while maintaining quality standards and guaranteeing team deliverables. Proficiency in computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software for 3D and 2D models. QHSE and Ethical Commitments The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing QHSE policies and ISO Procedures, adhering to safety rules, and ensuring compliance with Veolia’s specific sustainable development commitments. This includes following road traffic rules, maintaining office safety, and reporting any workplace issues. Additionally, compliance with applicable ethics and legislation referred to in the Veolia Code of Conduct policy, particularly regarding the fight against corruption and influence peddling, is mandatory. Veolia is an inclusive company committed to diversity and equal consideration for all applications.

041587d810d1adde.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجوهرات الفردان عن أخصائي مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى أخصائي المبيعات مسؤولية عرض وبيع المجوهرات الفاخرة، وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة لاحتياجات العملاء، وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق متميزة للعملاء والمساهمة في تطوير فرص البيع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة ومتابعة تطورات سوق المجوهرات الفاخرة، بما في ذلك اتجاهات العملاء والمنافسين، لتحديد فرص البيع واستقطاب عملاء جدد. عرض المنتجات وشرح خصائصها ومزاياها للعملاء، وتقديم التوصيات المناسبة لاحتياجاتهم، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. بناء علاقات طويلة الأمد مع العملاء، وتقديم الدعم والمعلومات اللازمة، ومتابعة احتياجاتهم، وتحديث بياناتهم باستخدام نظام إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM). تقديم تجربة تسوق متميزة تتوافق مع معايير مجوهرات الفردان، والمحافظة على جودة الخدمة والمظهر المهني الذي يعكس هوية الشركة. متابعة المنتجات الجديدة وتطوير المعرفة بالمجوهرات والقطاع من خلال المشاركة في التدريبات وورش العمل المتخصصة. التعامل مع عمليات نقل المخزون بين المعارض المختلفة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المجوهرات أو السلع الفاخرة. القدرة على بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء والحفاظ عليها. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على متابعة تطورات السوق والمنتجات. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الراتب الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

0498219d8029e055.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة نبض المستقبل المتطور عن محصل للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأشخاص، مع ضمان الدقة والالتزام بالسياسات المالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التحصيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد كشوفات تفصيلية بالمبالغ المستحقة من الجهات والأشخاص، بما في ذلك الإيرادات والمبالغ المستحقة. تحصيل المبالغ النقدية المستحقة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في الشركة. تسجيل المبالغ المحصلة وتحديث الكشوفات المالية بشكل مستمر ودقيق. المتابعة والتنسيق الفعال مع الأطراف المعنية لضمان تحصيل المبالغ، والرد على استفساراتهم المتعلقة بالمعاملات المالية. الالتزام التام بالتعليمات المتعلقة بسرية المعاملات المالية والتعامل معها بمهنية عالية. حفظ النسخ الورقية من سندات القبض والوثائق المالية الأخرى، وترتيبها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التحصيل أو ما يعادله. القدرة على إعداد الكشوفات المالية وتحصيل المبالغ النقدية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الجهات والأشخاص المعنيين. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المالية والإدارية. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، وتتطلب الالتزام التام بالدوام المحدد للقيام بمهام التحصيل والمتابعة. المهارات الشخصية الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تسجيل المعاملات المالية. القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات المالية بسرية تامة. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لحفظ الوثائق والسجلات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة نبض المستقبل المتطور.

04cc331defee92f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الرواد العالي للتدريب عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على بناء العلاقات مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين وعرض خدمات التدريب التي تقدمها الشركة، مع التركيز على إتمام عمليات البيع ومتابعة التحصيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء زيارات ميدانية للعملاء والشركات لعرض خدمات التدريب والتواصل الفعال معهم. جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات والخدمات التدريبية. بناء وتحديث قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. الاتصال بالعملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحية المخولة، وإتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير. متابعة تحصيل ديون العملاء وتسجيلها وتوثيقها وتوريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات أو دور مشابه. القدرة على إجراء زيارات ميدانية والتواصل المباشر مع العملاء. مهارات جيدة في جمع البيانات وإعداد التقارير. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. القدرة على بناء العلاقات والحفاظ عليها. مهارات تفاوض وإقناع لإتمام عمليات البيع. الالتزام بالمواعيد النهائية والقدرة على إدارة الوقت. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل تتطلب العمل الميداني في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل مندوب المبيعات ضمن فريق مبيعات ديناميكي لدعم أهداف الشركة في التوسع والوصول إلى قاعدة عملاء أوسع. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم.

Verify bug fixes and configuration changes, maintain release sign-off checklists, and track testing status for full visibility. Bug Investigation and Triage: Reproduce reported issues, isolate trigger conditions, and pinpoint their origin within workflows. Automated Workflow Monitoring: Monitor the health of running automations and integrations to detect failures proactively. 045b11664501a51a.description: نظرة عامة على الوظيفة تبحث شركة مصنع السعودية الراقية الدولية للجلود والدباغة عن مدير إنتاج صناعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف المباشر على عمليات الإنتاج والتصنيع، وضمان تنفيذ الخطط الإنتاجية بكفاءة ومطابقتها للمواصفات القياسية المطلوبة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد برامج الإنتاج والعمليات التصنيعية وفقاً للطرق والأساليب المحددة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الخطط والبرامج للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة. الإشراف على كافة العمليات اليومية للإنتاج الصناعي، وضمان تحديد الأساليب الأنسب لاستغلال الموارد المتاحة لإنتاج كميات محددة ضمن مواصفات جودة وتكاليف وجداول زمنية محددة. ضمان التنسيق الفعال مع كافة الجهات المعنية لتحديد كميات الإنتاج والمواصفات الفنية المطلوبة، بما يلبي رغبات العملاء ويقدم قيمة مضافة وميزة تنافسية. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد البحوث والدراسات الهادفة إلى تطوير عمليات الإنتاج، ورفع جودة المنتجات وكفاءة العمليات التصنيعية، وتقليل التكاليف والمدة الزمنية اللازمة للإنتاج. تطبيق مبادئ حديثة في الإنتاج لرفع الفعالية وتقليل الهدر أو التالف، وضبط المخزون. متابعة آخر المستجدات والتطورات المتعلقة بشؤون الإنتاج الصناعي، والتوجيه بتبني المناسب منها. تحديد وضمان توافر جميع الموارد والمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ الأعمال والأنشطة التخصصية بأحدث الأساليب والممارسات ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إدارة الإنتاج الصناعي. فهم عميق لعمليات وأساليب الإنتاج والتصنيع. القدرة على إعداد الخطط التشغيلية ومراقبة خطوط الإنتاج. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات واتخاذ القرارات. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق ممتازة. القدرة على متابعة التطورات التكنولوجية في مجال الإنتاج الصناعي. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تحقيق الكفاءة والجودة في عمليات الإنتاج. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة.

04d7dd09916aff23.description: تعلن شركة إعلاء للمقاولات العامة عن توفر فرصة وظيفة شاغرة بمقرها في الرياض بالمسمى الوظيفي: مهندس مدني (حديث التخرج). المتطلبات والشروط: أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية. حاصل على درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. حديث التخرج (بدون خبرة أو بخبرة بسيطة لا تتجاوز سنة). إجادة استخدام برامج الهندسة الأساسية (مثل AutoCAD وغيرها). القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والالتزام ببيئة العمل بالمواقع.

04064d3a115324da.company_name: شركة إم إيه بي كونسولت للاستشارات الهندسية
04064d3a115324da.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة بروفاست للمقاولات عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى المهندس المعماري مسؤولية تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات والمساعدة في اختيار المواقع والإشراف على أعمال الإنشاءات. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات الفنية. إعداد النماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات الفنية والنماذج الرقمية للمشاريع. المساعدة في عملية اختيار المقاولين والمواد اللازمة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم الفني لمشروعات الإنشاء والإشراف على تنفيذ التصميم من قبل المقاولين. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل المباني القائمة. معرفة بأسس ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. القدرة على إعداد الرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التصميم المعماري والتخطيط. القدرة على إدارة المشاريع والفرق الفنية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم المشورة والتنسيق مع الأطراف المختلفة. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة بروفاست للمقاولات، وستوفر بيئة عمل داعمة للمساهمة في مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة بروفاست للمقاولات كمهندس معماري، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة الخطوات التالية.

041d1a6e5faf1f88.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إمكانات المتكاملة للمقاولات عن أخصائي أمن سيبراني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم العام للأمن السيبراني والمساعدة في مهام الحماية والدفاع السيبراني. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق سياسات وضوابط الأمن السيبراني لتحقيق الأهداف الأمنية للنظام داخل الجهة. توصيف وتحليل حركة المرور على الشبكة لتحديد أي نشاط غير مألوف والتهديدات المحتملة لموارد الشبكات. التنسيق مع طاقم عمل الدفاع السيبراني على مستوى الجهة للتحقق من صحة تنبيهات الشبكات. تطوير وتوجيه اختبارات أنظمة الأمن السيبراني والقيام بإجراءات المصادقة والتوثيق. تقييم ومراقبة الأمن السيبراني فيما يتعلق بممارسات تطبيق الأنظمة واختبارها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الأمن السيبراني. فهم قوي لمبادئ وسياسات الأمن السيبراني. القدرة على تحليل حركة مرور الشبكة وتحديد التهديدات. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي الأمن السيبراني بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويسهم في تعزيز البنية الأمنية للشركة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

0438fefd2b32a8f3.description: About the Role KBR, Inc. is seeking a Senior Commercial Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring over 10 years of experience. The role involves reporting to the Senior Commercial Manager – Lead and is crucial for managing executive commercial reporting, strategy, and pre/post-contract activities for a major infrastructure program. Project Context The project is a significant infrastructure program for a mixed-use development in Riyadh, aiming to establish a global landmark and an authentic destination. This self-sustaining community will feature several iconic assets. KBR provides PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across all projects and programs within this development. Key Responsibilities Coordinate with Project Management Consultants (PMCs) for executive commercial reporting and control. Recommend and implement appropriate commercial strategies. Manage pre and post-contract activities, ensuring accurate status reports to prevent schedule slippage and cost overruns. Produce close-out reports for each project. Develop, implement, and govern standard cost and commercial reporting formats for PMCs. Maintain a database of all insurances, guarantees, and warranties. Compile and validate analytical commercial data with PMCs. Manage executive risk reporting. Develop Project Cost Reports (PCR), Commercial Executive Reports, and Cashflows within Unifier, integrating with other platforms for data consistency. Review existing procurement guidelines for Bills of Quantities (BoQ) and tender documents to develop standards for PMCs. Prepare program-wide consolidated cost reports consistent with agreed reporting requirements for various stakeholders. Collate annual program-wide budgets and prepare monthly cashflow reports for client submission. Prepare and develop cost benchmark reports, including Tender Price Index, Professional Fees Benchmark, and Construction Cost Benchmark. Prepare and issue cost benchmarking templates and elemental cost plan formats to PMCs. Participate in the development and implementation of program change control procedures. Prepare and issue program-wide project cash flow reports and project cost reports, including trend analysis and change reporting. Review cost risks and opportunities, linking Cost Break Down Structure and Work Breakdown Structure, including Earned Value. Prepare updates for changes on the program baseline budget and support business plan exercises. Provide portfolio-wide risk management services to support effective governance, decision-making, and assurance. Consolidate PMC risk registers into program-level and departmental risk registers. Assist the client with the development of commercial strategy. Lead and direct contracts, risk, and other support service departments, ensuring timely production of all required commercial deliverables by KBR. Produce Commercial Reports throughout the project's life cycle. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is required. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Information Salary details for this position are not disclosed.

043c4eda334ff72a.description: About the Role United Motors Company is seeking a Technician to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on vehicle inspection, maintenance, diagnosis, and repair activities. Job Purpose The primary purpose of this role is to perform vehicle inspection, maintenance, diagnosis, and repair activities. The Technician will ensure all services are conducted in accordance with manufacturer standards and dealership procedures, maintaining high standards of safety, efficiency, and quality. Key Responsibilities Perform routine vehicle maintenance, servicing, and mechanical repairs. Inspect vehicles to identify mechanical faults and maintenance requirements. Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical issues using appropriate tools and diagnostic equipment. Carry out repairs and replacement of defective mechanical components. Perform oil changes, brake servicing, suspension repairs, cooling system maintenance, and other general mechanical work. Follow manufacturer repair procedures, technical specifications, and dealership standards. Use workshop tools, equipment, and diagnostic systems safely and correctly. Conduct vehicle inspections before and after repairs to ensure the work has been completed properly. Maintain accurate records of repairs, parts used, and work performed. Communicate identified vehicle issues and additional repair requirements to the Service Advisor or Workshop Supervisor. Ensure all work is completed within the assigned time and productivity standards. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work area. Comply with company policies, safety procedures, and environmental requirements. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in vehicle maintenance and repair. Specific qualifications were not provided but will be assessed during the application process. Work Environment This full-time role is based in Dammam, Eastern Region, within a workshop environment. The Technician will work as part of a team dedicated to delivering high-quality vehicle services. Application Process Salary details for this position are not disclosed. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply.

043f3828d382437f.job_title: Passenger Service Agent Flynas RUH Station
043f3828d382437f.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking a Passenger Service Agent for its Flynas ELQ Station in Al Qassim, Al Qasim, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive passenger and customer services as contracted by the customer, ensuring a smooth and positive experience for all travelers. Key Responsibilities Prepare and clear check-in counters with appropriate stationery and signage before and after flights. Welcome passengers at check-in and other customer service touchpoints, assisting in providing a pleasant customer experience. Verify travel documentation and check-in departing passengers according to standard operating procedures. Counter-check boarding passes, make announcements, and ensure efficient passenger boarding. Assist customers during flight irregularities such as delays, cancellations, or diverted flights, coordinating communication to maintain a positive passenger experience. Maintain excellent customer service standards consistently. Perform duties related to Check-In, Gate, Transfers, and Lost & Found. Charge applicable excess baggage fees. Assist passengers through arrival and check-in processes, including support for special needs passengers such as unaccompanied minors (UM), VIPs, and those requiring wheelchair assistance. Direct passengers through Customs, Immigration, and Quarantine as required. Manage Gate activities, including set-up, communication with the Flight Coordinator, flight close-out, boarding process, accuracy of final passenger figures, initiating searches for missing passengers, and communicating baggage details for missing passengers. Contribute to the on-time performance of flights through proactive handling of Passenger Service matters. Make public address announcements as needed (*, delay, boarding, last call). Assist the Ramp team to ensure wheelchairs, strollers, and gate-checked bags (cleared through security) are available for loading upon departure and delivery upon arrival. Adhere to and comply with all Standard Operating Procedures (Swissport & Carrier Specific). Operate equipment such as computer keyboards and carrier-specific reservation/ticketing software. Produce all required work-related documentation. Uphold and protect the company’s interests and image at the Terminal/Airside. Protect customer (airlines) supplied products (*, boarding passes, tags, signage) from loss or damage by strictly adhering to written procedures. Ensure compliance with uniform standards in line with appearance and personal protective equipment policies where applicable. Provide relevant information to customer queries and offer solutions to issues impacting the customer’s experience. Report all irregularities to the appropriate supervisor/manager. Carry out any additional duties as instructed by management. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience in a relevant field. Ability to perform a variety of passenger service duties. Strong commitment to maintaining high customer service standards. Required Skills Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in operating computer keyboards and carrier-specific reservation/ticketing software. Ability to handle multiple tasks and work effectively in a fast-paced environment. Problem-solving skills, particularly during flight irregularities. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the Flynas ELQ Station in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia, requiring adherence to strict operational procedures and uniform standards. Application Process Candidates meeting the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this role to contribute to passenger service operations at Swissport KSA.

045617e2d16674bf.description: About Al Rugaib Al Rugaib focuses on enhancing everyday living by providing thoughtfully curated home environments. The company aims to offer accessibility, variety, and reliability in its product offerings. Its primary target audience includes middle- to upper-income households, young professionals establishing homes, and design-conscious consumers across Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC region. The Role of Stock Controller Al Rugaib is seeking a Stock Controller to manage inventory operations within the showroom. This full-time role is critical for maintaining accurate stock records and ensuring efficient handling of inbound and outbound items. Key Responsibilities Control inbound and outbound stock within the showroom. Receive stock transfers, then label and price newly received items. Process showroom pickup items, including sorting and invoicing. Prepare and dispatch items for delivery from the warehouse. Cross-match all inventory transactions across physical stock, Wasp, and Dynamics systems. Respond to inventory inquiries for reports and counting purposes. Perform continuous cycle counting, ensuring at least one full count per quarter. Report any discrepancies or violations related to stock. Update product prices as required. Performance Indicators Success in this role will be measured by key performance indicators including: Showroom Accuracy Number of Transactions Work Type This is a full-time position.

04c3fea679982188.description: About Al Rabie Saudi Foods Co. Al Rabie Saudi Foods Co. is a prominent Saudi company and a trusted manufacturer of juices and beverages. The company produces a diverse portfolio including 100% juices, nectars, dairy beverages, and functional drinks, distributed across Saudi Arabia and international markets. Headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Al Rabie is recognized for its legacy of quality and innovation within Saudi households. Role Overview The Business Analyst – Sales & Commercial reports directly to the Chief Sales Officer (CSO) and is responsible for transforming complex commercial data into actionable insights. This role supports strategic decision-making across six sales channels: Modern Trade, Wholesale, Van Operations, International Markets, E-Commerce, and Sales Transformation & Systems. The Business Analyst serves as the analytical foundation for the commercial function, enabling the CSO and senior leadership to make informed decisions efficiently. This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain the commercial performance reporting framework across all six sales channels. Develop and manage daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance dashboards, tracking volume, value, distribution, and channel health metrics. Prepare Monthly Business Review (MBR) and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) commercial packs for the CSO and CEO, including performance narratives and variance commentary. Automate recurring reports to enhance data accuracy and consistency, ensuring timely availability to senior leadership. Conduct deep-dive analyses on sales trends, channel performance, SKU contribution, customer segmentation, and market share. Identify commercial performance gaps, root causes, and emerging risks across channels, geographies, and product portfolios. Analyze distributor, customer, and channel productivity to identify growth and efficiency opportunities. Build scenario models and sensitivity analyses to support commercial decisions, such as pricing evaluations, promotional ROI, and route-to-market assessments. Support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process with data-driven demand signals and channel-level volume forecasts. Assist in developing the annual commercial operating plan (AOP), bottom-up budgets, and phased sales targets by channel, category, and geography. Track forecast accuracy and collaborate with commercial teams to improve planning precision. Provide analytical support for new product introduction planning, including market sizing, cannibalization assessment, and launch performance tracking. Support sales transformation initiatives, including route-to-market redesign and channel investment reallocation. Evaluate partnership and distribution opportunities through financial modeling and commercial due diligence. Assist in building business cases for commercial investment decisions. Collaborate with IT, Finance, and Supply Chain to improve data infrastructure, ERP reporting, and commercial system capabilities. Act as the data and analytics liaison, ensuring consistent commercial definitions and reporting standards. Stakeholder Management and Communication Translate complex data into concise, boardroom-ready presentations and executive summaries for the CSO and CEO. Present findings and recommendations to senior commercial leadership, proactively highlighting risks and opportunities. Build strong working relationships with channel heads, finance business partners, and marketing teams to ensure integrated analytical outputs. Respond to ad-hoc analytical requests from the CSO and commercial leadership with speed, accuracy, and appropriate depth of insight. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in a business analyst role, preferably within sales or commercial functions. The role requires a strong analytical background and the ability to translate data into strategic insights. Why Join Al Rabie? Al Rabie Saudi Foods offers a dynamic environment where commercial talent can contribute to a category-leading portfolio. This role provides an opportunity to impact strategic retail partnerships for a recognized beverage brand within the Kingdom.

043c60ee4c4b2aab.company_name: Mohammad Al Habib Real Estate Co.
043c60ee4c4b2aab.description: About the Role Outdoor Factory MEA is seeking a Cost Control Engineer to join their team in Jizan, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for managing the financial aspects of a new family entertainment center project, from initial development through to opening day. The successful candidate will ensure financial precision and contribute to the project's overall success. Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain the project budget and cost breakdown structure. Prepare monthly cost reports, cash flow projections, and forecasts. Compare actual costs against budget, analyze variances, and recommend corrective actions. Track subcontractor and supplier payment certificates, purchase orders, and contract costs. Link quantities and progress data to cost, and conduct Earned Value Management (EVM) analyses. Assess the cost impact of variation and change orders. Collaborate with the planning team to integrate time and cost data. Provide clear and confident reporting to senior management and clients. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering. 8 years of cost control or project controls experience on site-based projects. Experience in family entertainment centers, malls, theme parks, tourism/leisure facilities, or other large-scale building projects. International experience is preferred. Working knowledge of Primavera P6 and MS Project. Advanced MS Excel skills; proficiency in Power BI or similar reporting tools is a plus. Strong command of EVM, cash flow, and forecasting principles. Solid understanding of FIDIC and contract management. Good English language skills; Arabic is an advantage. Previous experience in Saudi Arabia is a plus. Work Environment This role is based in Jizan, Saudi Arabia, and involves working on-site for the development of a family entertainment center. The position is full-time, requiring a commitment to managing project finances from inception to completion. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

040a2ef960748952.description: About the Role Hilton is seeking a Training Executive to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on coordinating and delivering training programs that align with hotel priorities and support employee development. The Training Executive will contribute to fostering a positive and productive training environment within the hotel. Key Responsibilities Execute the in-house training plan by coordinating and delivering high-quality training programs that align with hotel priorities. Identify and support training needs in partnership with line managers, department heads, HR, and the Training Manager. This includes assessing development needs, implementing learning initiatives, and reviewing progress monthly. Administer required training courses, coordinating legal, compliance, and vocational qualification programs to ensure employees meet standards and progress professionally. Engage and connect trainers across the hotel by leading monthly meetings to share progress, review needs, and ensure consistent training delivery. Inspire and develop the team by supporting team members, monitoring performance, providing coaching, and fostering a positive training environment. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will demonstrate a passion for hospitality, acting with integrity, and inspiring others through leadership. A belief in teamwork, a sense of ownership, and a focus on bringing urgency and discipline to daily tasks are essential qualities for success in this role. Required Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. About Hilton Hilton is a global leader in hospitality, recognized for its workplace culture and commitment to providing exceptional experiences for guests and team members. The company has received repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. Hilton focuses on its founding vision to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality, supporting team members' career journeys. Location and Work Type This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time role.

04259b9f10cf7a59.description: About Closer Core Closer Core is a business solutions company focused on helping organizations achieve growth, enhance customer experience, increase revenue, and access new business opportunities. Our services encompass customer acquisition, marketing, business development, sponsorship opportunities, government-related solutions, and business consulting. The Opportunity: Business Development Partner Closer Core is seeking a Business Development Partner to identify new clients, build relationships with decision-makers, and generate new business opportunities. This is a contract, commission-only position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, with earnings directly tied to successful business and projects brought to the company. This role is particularly suited for individuals with a strong professional network and access to business owners and decision-makers. Key Responsibilities Identify and approach potential clients and businesses. Generate new business opportunities and leads. Introduce Closer Core and its solutions to potential clients. Build and maintain relationships with business owners, executives, and decision-makers. Understand potential clients’ needs and identify relevant solutions. Arrange meetings and introductions between qualified prospects and the Closer Core team. Follow up with prospects and support the business development process. Develop long-term relationships with clients. Bring new projects and opportunities to Closer Core. Candidate Profile Strong communication and networking skills. An entrepreneurial and results-driven mindset. Confidence in communicating with business owners and decision-makers. Ability to identify and develop business opportunities. A strong professional network or the ability to build one. Experience in sales, business development, marketing, consulting, sponsorships, or government services is preferred. Existing relationships with companies, executives, business owners, or decision-makers are considered a strong advantage. Compensation and Location This is a commission-only position with no fixed monthly salary or guaranteed compensation. Earnings are based on successful business generated through clients and opportunities brought to Closer Core. Commission details and payment terms will be discussed during the interview. Candidates based in Riyadh are strongly preferred, as the role involves developing relationships with businesses and decision-makers in the city. Familiarity with the local business environment and an existing Riyadh-based network will be advantageous. Application Process We are interested in building long-term professional relationships with individuals who demonstrate strong performance and commitment. To apply, please send your CV along with a brief introduction detailing your experience, professional network, and the types of companies or industries you can connect with.

0451fac78bb22a52.description: About the Role SFC is seeking a Modern Trade Key Account Officer to join their team in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing key accounts within modern trade channels, ensuring the achievement of sales and collection targets. The position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The Modern Trade Key Account Officer is responsible for driving key performance indicators, including volume, visibility, and collection, across assigned accounts. This involves strategic planning, execution of commercial activities, and close collaboration with various departments to ensure operational efficiency and financial compliance. Key Responsibilities Achieve annual and monthly sales targets set by the head office. Ensure the execution of all planned activities and contractual agreements (BDAs) for managed accounts.
